_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan. Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.
Solve the riddle!
Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Talk to Malton Droffers in Orgrimmar.
Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.
Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge. Whenever you find a hot spot, right click the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.
Travel to Winterspring and speak with Donova Snowden.
Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.
Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity. Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.
Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.
Sprinkle wants to you take the Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak to him again after he creates his elixir.
Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.
Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.
Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.
Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.
Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
Listen to Loramus Thalipedes tell his story.
Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.
Wait for Trenton to finish his work.
Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.
Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.

o.t: Protect Captain Vanessa Beltis from the naga attack

quests.t: Defend Captain Vanessa Beltis, her crew and the Horizon Scout's passengers against the naga attack. Captain Vanessa Beltis must survive.
Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.
Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.
Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.
Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.
Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.
Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.
Bring the Tablet of Sael'hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
Deliver Magatha's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.
Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain. Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.
Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.
Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.
Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns. Bring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol'anyee Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.
Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.
Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.
Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.
Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.
Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.
Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge. Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.
Defend Gor'shak.

Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar. You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.
Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris. Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas. After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.
Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.
Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.
Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.
Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.
Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.
Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.
Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

o.t: Protect A-Me 01 until you reach Karna Remtravel

quests.t: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.
Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.
Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.
Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.
Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.
Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.
Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

quests.n: A Little Help From My Friends

o.t: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge

quests.t: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge. If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.

o.t: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge

quests.t: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.
Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.
Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.
Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

o.t: Return the corrupted cat to Winna Hazzard
Release the kitten near the Jadefire Satyrs' corrupted moonwell.

quests.t: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna. Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.
Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned. Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.
Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.
Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.
Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

quests.n: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.t: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

quests.n: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.t: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.
Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

o.t: Explore the craters in Shatter Scar Vale

quests.t: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.
Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

o.t: Protect Arko'narin out of Shadow Hold

quests.t: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.
Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.

Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key. Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the…
Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quatermaster in Frostwolf Keep.
Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Fera…
Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond. Find a way to speak with Celebras.
Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras. Speak with him when the ritual is complete.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.
Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations. The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold th…

Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core. R…
Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Fera…
Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.
Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.
Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
Speak to Ogtinc in Azshara.
Bring a pair of Perfect Courser Antlers to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.
Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in Ravenholdt Manor.
Bring 10 Encoded Fragments to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
Seek out Sanath Lim-yo and gain passage to see Archmage Xylem.
Bring 10 Glittering Dust to Archmage Xylem.
Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.
Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
Seek out Ogtinc in Azshara.
Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
Look for information about cooking Sandworm Meat at the Twilight's Hammer camp west of Cenarion Hold.
Bring the Torn Recipe Page to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold.
Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.
Collect a sample of air, fire, earth and water for Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the entrance to the Blasted Lands.
Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.
Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.
Bring 10 Rotting Wood and 4 Bloodvenom Essence to Impsy in Felwood.
Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.
Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Stab a Devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb. Return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater when you have completed this task.
Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
Speak with Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
